correctness.rationale: The fixed-set orbit-barycenter triangulation is exact, and the 30 original arrows have 15 involution orbits, of which 12 are individually forests. Pairwise compatibility yields the explicit connected 12-vertex, 36-edge graph, and there are no triangular faces. All 24 elements of the faithful residual S4 are checked with exact integer signed chain traces, independently reproduced by direct action on 25 fundamental cycle basis vectors; these agree elementwise. Standard S4 character orthogonality gives integral nonnegative multiplicities [1,1,3,4,1] with dimension 25; the quotient rational invariants follow from finite-group averaging. This is a finite exact proof with a standalone program, not extrapolated from partial examples.

value.rationale: The exact first positive-dimensional involution-fixed complete directed-forest example is a natural place to ask whether the 25 circles are individually symmetric. The answer gives all five S4 conjugacy traces, distinguishes elements that fix the same number of original pairs, detects nontrivial signed 3D constituents and an unexpected single full-symmetry invariant. The full residual character is a complete natural equivariant invariant, not a routine restatement of the known Betti number. It informs quotient topology and shows how the stabilizer geometry refines classical fixed-space sphere-wedge classifications.
